selection_rule: Among B1, B2, C and D: the strategy passing every gate on the exploratory seeds, highest unique-configuration mean diversity first; if none passes every gate, none is chosen and the best by unique-configuration mean diversity among those passing the signal, repeat-rate and p95 gates is carried to held-out as the guarded candidate. All strategies are also re-run on the held-out seeds for transparency; held-out results never feed back into selection.

scoring.unique_configurations: Phase 2H.9 rule C: chill/match and stressed/uplift count once (6)
scoring.baselines: Phase 2H.9 rule B: guarded variants use the guarded calm random-eligible baseline
scoring.gap_to_baseline_closed: supplementary, not a gate: (strategy - control) / (baseline - control) per configuration where the control is below its baseline

notes: Diversity is feature-space diversity (mean pairwise distance in the 9 z-scored audio features), not a direct measure of listener-perceived variety.
Bootstrap intervals resample one request's 50 runs on one catalog: sampling variability only.
Precision/NDCG are omitted: relevance is the eligibility definition, so they cannot rank strategies.
Latency is machine-dependent; strategies ran sequentially in one process; cold start uses fresh interpreters on sad/match.
